name: Mongolia

flag.description: Three equal vertical bands of red, blue and red, with the gold Soyombo symbol in the hoist-side red band.
flag.symbolism: Blue represents the eternal blue sky and red progress and prosperity; the Soyombo combines fire, sun, moon and other elements standing for the nation and its independence.

hook: Mongolia is red-blue-red vertical with a golden totem of fire, sun and moon (the Soyombo) on the left-hand red band.
trivia: The Soyombo symbol is a character from a script created by the monk Zanabazar in 1686.
Ulaanbaatar is the coldest national capital in the world by average annual temperature.
